cross_rules.economic_rationale: Trend must be confirmed by participation, volume, liquidity or path quality.
Reversal is conditioned on pressure, gap geometry or an observable volatility extreme.
Direction mechanism changes only when a causal volatility or path regime changes.
A base market signal may be filtered by volatility, credit or financial stress.
Slow valuation or macro state combines only with market trend, rates or credit.
Market direction is confirmed by broad public factor and industry participation.
SPY state may interact with bonds, currencies, commodities and global risk signals.
Only preregistered public releases or events may condition a pre-existing market state.
Ensembles combine a small number of distinct simple mechanisms.
Trend or reversal may be conditioned on causal scale, entropy, cycle or path structure.
Price signals may interact with liquidity, financing, positioning and aggregate flows.
Models receive only approved causal inputs and retain the global five-feature cap.
Volatility and positioning families may form a bounded risk-sentiment composite.
Forecast combinations mix frozen outputs using only past error or bounded voting weights.

observable CFTC concentration only, never option strikes or walls: top4_level and top8_level are rolling z-scores of absolute combined net top-four/top-eight concentration; top4_top8_share=clip(abs(top4_combined)/abs(top8_combined),0,2); combined_gap=rolling_z(abs(top4_combined)-abs(top4_futures),window); change=rolling_z(diff(abs(top8_combined)-abs(top8_futures),lag),window)

realized common-correlation proxy, never a Cboe implied-correlation index: for each industry compute a trailing-window z-return with at least ceil(0.9*window) observations; at each date retain available z-returns only and require at least max(2,ceil(0.8*N_total)) industries; daily_pair_product=((sum_i z_i)^2-sum_i z_i^2)/(N_available*(N_available-1)); common_correlation is its trailing-window mean with at least ceil(0.9*window) observations, clipped [-1,1], and remains unavailable before row 2*window-2; variance_gap=(VIX/100)^2-252*rolling_mean(SPY_log_return^2,window); correlation_state and variance_state are rolling z-scores; correlation_gap=correlation_state-variance_state, interaction=correlation_state*variance_state clipped [-20,20]

close-to-close redesign without VVIX or SKEW claims: vol30 is the contemporaneously public bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter, never recalculated pre-publication VIX; vol_of_vol=sqrt(252)*rolling_std(diff(log(vol30)),window); methodology_disagreement=log(vol30/VXO); causal tail cutoff at t is quantile(SPY log returns t-window...t-1,tail_quantile), realized_tail=sqrt(252*rolling_mean(return^2*I(return<=cutoff),window)); convexity_interaction=rolling_z(vol_of_vol,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(realized_tail,window))+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(abs(methodology_disagreement),window))) clipped [-20,20]

declared daily proxy, not an intraday jump estimator or option-implied expected return; implied variance uses the contemporaneously public vol30 bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter: RV=252*rolling_mean(SPY_log_return^2,window); BV=252*pi/2*rolling_mean(abs(return_t)*abs(return_t-1),window); jump=max(RV-BV,0); variance_premium=(vol30/100)^2-RV; continuous_premium=(vol30/100)^2-BV; jump_share=clip(jump/RV,0,1); risk_compensation=rolling_z(variance_premium,window)*(1+jump_share) clipped [-20,20]

tail-insurance proxy only, never an OTM put wing; implied volatility uses the contemporaneously public vol30 bridge VXO before 2003-09-22 and disseminated VIX thereafter: compute realized_tail and tail_realization=tail_variance/total_realized_variance from the F091 causal tail rule; implied_downside_gap=log((vol30/100)/realized_tail); on native Friday-available CFTC rows positioning_pressure=rolling_z(abs(noncommercial_net_pct_oi_combined-noncommercial_net_pct_oi),positioning_window), then align backward; insurance_interaction=rolling_z(implied_downside_gap,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(positioning_pressure)+0.5*tail_realization) clipped [-20,20]

expiry-conditioned end-of-day redesign, never dealer gamma or strike exposure: weight=clip((event_window-sessions_until_standard_expiry)/event_window,0,1); range_compression=-rolling_z(log(high/low),window); expiry_pinning=weight*range_compression; convexity_pressure=weight*rolling_z(VIX,window)*(1+0.5*tanh(rolling_z(abs(SPY_log_return),window))); quarterly_pressure=expiry_pinning*I(current_session_is_quarterly_expiry); reversal_pressure=weight*rolling_z(-sign(log(open/previous_close))*log(close/open),window)

realized Treasury-yield volatility proxy, never MOVE: across every available H15 yield maturity daily_curve_move=sqrt(mean(diff(yield_decimal)^2)); rate_volatility=sqrt(252*rolling_mean(daily_curve_move^2,window)); volatility_ratio=log(rate_volatility/(VIX/100)); divergence=rolling_z(rate_volatility,window)-rolling_z(VIX/100,window); shock=rolling_z(diff(rate_volatility,change_lag),window)-rolling_z(diff(VIX/100,change_lag),window)

historically available monetary-liquidity redesign: after conservative H.3/H.6 publication delays compute growth=diff(log(level),growth_lag) for monetary_base,total_reserves,M2 and rolling_z each over window; policy= -rolling_z(diff(effective_fed_funds_aligned_backward,growth_lag),window); net_liquidity=mean(base,reserves,money,policy); reserve_impulse=reserves; money_impulse=mean(base,money); policy_adjusted=mean(reserves,money,policy); no TGA, repo or RRP is claimed

after frozen H.8/H.6/commercial-paper publication delays compute growth=diff(log(level),growth_lag) and rolling z-scores over window for bank_credit,loans_and_leases,M2,commercial_paper; growth_breadth=mean(sign(raw growth)); credit_impulse=mean(z(bank_credit),z(loans),z(commercial_paper)); contraction_pressure=mean(max(-credit_z,0)); money_credit_gap=z(M2)-credit_impulse

causal first-release surprise redesign without survey consensus: separately for payroll,industrial_production,housing_starts,output,consumption, forecast_t=previous_release+mean(prior changes over forecast_window), error_t=actual_first_release-forecast_t, scale_t=std(prior errors over scale_window), standardized_surprise=error_t/scale_t; forward-fill only already published standardized states across release rows; surprise_breadth=mean(sign(states)), surprise_magnitude=mean(abs(states)), growth_surprise=mean(states), dispersion=population_std(states), requiring at least two available series

using only first-release CPI,core CPI,core PCE states, inflation_level=mean(latest published levels); for each series use the F098 causal forecast and prior-error scaling, inflation_surprise=mean(latest standardized surprises); inflation_trend=mean(latest rolling mean of release-to-release changes over forecast_window); inflation_acceleration=mean(latest change in those trends)

scheduled public FOMC decision proxy, never a fed-funds-futures surprise or text tone: emit only next-session decision events; policy_change=diff(effective_fed_funds between events); inflation=mean(latest first-release CPI,core CPI,core PCE), real_rate=effective_fed_funds-inflation; growth=mean(latest output_first,consumption_first); rule_rate=2+inflation+0.5*(inflation-inflation_target)+0.5*(growth-2), rule_gap=effective_fed_funds-rule_rate; event_interaction=0.5*(rolling_z(policy_change,normalization_window)+rolling_z(rule_gap,normalization_window))*(1+0.25*statement_flag+0.5*conference_call_flag) clipped [-20,20]

aggregate calendar redesign, never constituent announcements: e_change=diff(log(aggregate_earnings)) and d_change=diff(log(aggregate_dividends)); each seasonal prior is mean(value[t-12*k] for k=1..seasonal_window when known), earnings_news=e_change-prior_e and dividend_news=d_change-prior_d; news_seasonality=(rolling_z(earnings_news,window)+rolling_z(dividend_news,window))/2; quarterly_cycle=news_seasonality*cos(2*pi*(known_quarter-1)/4)

aggregate redesign, never analyst revisions or breadth: earnings_momentum=diff(log(aggregate_earnings),momentum_lag); earnings_yield_change=diff(earnings_yield,momentum_lag); acceleration=diff(earnings_momentum,momentum_lag); composite=mean(rolling_z(each of the three states,window))

aggregate earnings-dividend decomposition with no margin claim: earnings_growth=diff(log(aggregate_earnings),growth_lag); dividend_growth=diff(log(aggregate_dividends),growth_lag); payout_change=diff(payout_ratio,growth_lag); decomposition=mean(rolling_z(earnings_growth,window),rolling_z(dividend_growth,window),-rolling_z(abs(payout_change),window))

aggregate issuance proxy only, never buybacks or insider transactions: market_issuance=rolling_z(Goyal_ntis,window); align 13-month-delayed Z1 FA103164105.Q backward to each Goyal month, z1_issuance=rolling_z(diff(aligned_net_issuance,change_lag),window); agreement=(market_issuance+z1_issuance)/2; retirement_pressure=(max(-market_issuance,0)+max(-z1_issuance,0))/2

intermediary-capacity proxy, never firm dealer capital: for bank_credit,loans_and_leases,commercial_paper compute rolling_z(diff(log(level),growth_lag),window), credit_impulse=mean(the three); funding_stress=mean(rolling_z(financial_conditions_score,window),rolling_z(BAA_minus_AAA,window)); balance_sheet_capacity=credit_impulse-funding_stress; capacity_disagreement=credit_impulse+funding_stress

contemporaneous free-input redesign: compute rolling z-scores over window for uncertainty_score,volatility_level,absolute_rate_change and aligned financial_conditions_score; uncertainty_level is its z-score, stress_composite=mean(all four), disagreement=uncertainty_level-financial_conditions_state, persistence=rolling_mean(stress_composite,persistence_window)

recession-pressure proxy, never a published recession probability: on official Philadelphia vintage dates growth_state=mean(rolling_z(realtime_output_growth,window),mean rolling_z of latest first-release industrial_production,output,consumption); labor_state=-rolling_z(realtime_unemployment+unemployment_change,window); curve_state=rolling_z(yield_10y-yield_3m,window); recession_pressure=-(growth_state+labor_state+curve_state)/3

expectations proxy only, never consumer or business survey expectations: at first-release macro dates activity_state=mean rolling_z(payroll,industrial_production,housing_starts,output,consumption over window); uncertainty_state=rolling_z(latest uncertainty_score,window); expectation_proxy=rolling_mean(activity_state shifted one release,trend_window)-uncertainty_state; deterioration=-(activity_state-activity_state[t-trend_window]); disagreement=expectation_proxy-activity_state

quarterly public sentiment proxy, never analyst or retail surveys: align already available uncertainty,CFTC and contemporaneously public volatility backward to 13-month-delayed Z1 dates; allocation_state=mean rolling_z(household_equity_share,mutual_fund_equity_share,window); positioning_state=mean rolling_z(futures-only and combined noncommercial_net_pct_oi,window); uncertainty_state=-rolling_z(uncertainty_score,window); volatility_state=-rolling_z(vol30,window); sentiment_composite=mean(all four states); disagreement=population_std(all four states)

monthly WTI-gold redesign, with no copper claim: oil_gold_ratio=log(WTI/gold); oil_momentum=diff(log(WTI),momentum_lag), gold_momentum=diff(log(gold),momentum_lag); relative_momentum=oil_momentum-gold_momentum; inflation_impulse=rolling_z(oil_momentum,window); shock_divergence=rolling_z(oil_momentum,window)-rolling_z(gold_momentum,window)

broad-US industry proxy: cyclical_return and defensive_return are equal-weight means of frozen French 48-industry groups; cyclical_defensive_spread=rolling_sum(cyclical-defensive,window); leadership_breadth=rolling_mean(mean_sign_cyclical-mean_sign_defensive,window); rotation=rolling_z(cyclical,window)-rolling_z(defensive,window); dispersion_gap=rolling_mean(cyclical_cross_section_std-defensive_cross_section_std,window)

broad-US FF3 proxy, never S&P constituent leadership: size_leadership=rolling_sum(SMB,window); value_leadership=rolling_sum(HML,window); factor_rotation=rolling_z(SMB,window)-rolling_z(HML,window); market_confirmation=rolling_z(Mkt_RF,window)*sign((size_leadership+value_leadership)/2)

stock_return=diff(log(SPY_close)); Treasury duration-return proxy=-7*diff(yield10y/100); stock_bond_correlation=rolling_corr(stock_return,bond_proxy,window); curve_momentum=diff(yield10y-yield3m,momentum_lag); duration_momentum=rolling_sum(bond_proxy,momentum_lag); joint_shock=rolling_z(stock_return,window)+rolling_z(bond_proxy,window)

official H15 only: credit_stress=rolling_z(BAA-AAA,window); funding_stress=rolling_z(BAA-yield10y,window); policy_pressure=rolling_z(yield3m-effective_fed_funds,window); stress_composite=mean(the three)

currency redesign, never equity-session returns: calculate momentum_lag log changes; dollar_momentum=rolling_z(broad_dollar_change,window); safe_haven_rotation=mean rolling_z(JPY,CHF changes); cyclical_rotation=mean rolling_z(CAD,GBP changes); dispersion=cross_currency population_std of changes

industry common-mode proxy without constituent PCA: common_mode=equal_weight_industry_return; common_share=clip(rolling_var(common_mode,window)/mean_industry_rolling_variance,0,1); average_correlation=clip((N*common_share-1)/(N-1),-1,1); dispersion=rolling_mean(cross_industry_population_std,window)

industry breadth proxy: breadth=rolling_mean(mean(sign(industry_returns)),window); acceleration=diff(breadth,change_lag); spy_momentum=diff(log(SPY_close),window); divergence=rolling_z(breadth,window)-rolling_z(spy_momentum,window); failure_pressure=-sign(spy_momentum)*acceleration

redesign without constituent earnings breadth: build 20-session cyclical-defensive industry signal and align it backward to 13-month-delayed aggregate earnings dates; earnings_state=rolling_z(diff(log(aggregate_earnings),growth_lag),window); industry_state=rolling_z(aligned_industry_signal,window); alignment=mean(earnings_state,industry_state); leadership_gap=industry_state-earnings_state

declared causal state combination, not an outcome-fitted ensemble: on each SPY decision date construct rolling-z trend,industry breadth,FF3 market,10y-3m curve,-financial_conditions,first-release macro activity and negative public vol30 states over window; mean_forecast,median_forecast,consensus=mean(sign(states)),disagreement=population_std(states), requiring all seven states

causal analog search over the first features from the seven F119 states: at date t candidate j must satisfy j<=t-embargo and j+horizon<=t; select neighbors smallest Euclidean distances using only states known at t; emit neighbor_mean,neighbor_median,up_probability or neighbor_dispersion of already realized SPY log returns j to j+horizon; require embargo>=horizon

next-session SPY: prior_high=rolling_max(high.shift(1),window); prior_low=rolling_min(low.shift(1),window); high_distance=close/prior_high-1; low_distance=close/prior_low-1; range_position=2*(close-prior_low)/(prior_high-prior_low)-1; confirmed_breakout is +1 or -1 only after confirmation consecutive closes beyond the buffered prior range, otherwise 0

next-session SPY Wilder system: TR=max(high-low,abs(high-close.shift(1)),abs(low-close.shift(1))); plus_dm and minus_dm use mutually exclusive directional moves; DI=100*Wilder(DM,window)/Wilder(TR,window); ADX=Wilder(100*abs(plus_DI-minus_DI)/(plus_DI+minus_DI),window); Aroon uses argmax high and argmin low inside the completed rolling window; directional_strength=sign(DI_spread)*ADX/100

next-session SPY with adjust_false EMA: MACD=(EMA_fast-EMA_slow)-EMA_signal(EMA_fast-EMA_slow); PPO=100*(EMA_fast/EMA_slow-1)-EMA_signal(PPO_line); TRIX=100*diff(log(EMA_fast(EMA_fast(EMA_fast(close))))); TSI=100*EMA_fast(EMA_slow(diff(close)))/EMA_fast(EMA_slow(abs(diff(close)))); require fast<slow

causal next-session Ichimoku, never forward-shift: conversion=(rolling_max(high,conversion_window)+rolling_min(low,conversion_window))/2; base analogous; span_a=(conversion+base)/2; span_b uses span_b_window; divide conversion-base, close-cloud-midpoint and span_a-span_b by Wilder ATR; cloud_breakout is sign outside the contemporaneously known cloud; require conversion_window<base_window<span_b_window

next-session SPY: standard stateful Parabolic SAR with acceleration_step capped at acceleration_max and prior-two-bar clamps; standard recursive Supertrend final bands from Wilder ATR; Chandelier long=rolling_max(high,window)-atr_multiplier*ATR and short=rolling_min(low,window)+atr_multiplier*ATR; each score is close minus its causal level divided by ATR and consensus is the mean of their signs

closed prior-range levels only: H=rolling_max(high.shift(1),window); L=rolling_min(low.shift(1),window); C=close.shift(1); pivot=(H+L+C)/3; S1=2*pivot-H; R1=2*pivot-L; Fibonacci levels=L+{0.382,0.500,0.618}*(H-L); emit normalized pivot distance, S1-R1 position, four-bin Fibonacci position or signed distance to nearest frozen level

next-session SPY causal path transforms: Heikin-Ashi close=mean(O,H,L,C) and open_t=(HA_open_{t-1}+HA_close_{t-1})/2; Renko emits last brick direction using box_atr times prior Wilder ATR; Point-and-Figure uses the same prior box and close-only continuation or reversal after reversal_boxes; consensus is the mean sign, with no intrabar ordering assumption

deterministic trailing-window patterns only: triangle requires negative high slope and positive low slope; wedge requires same-sign high and low slopes with narrowing range; double_extreme compares first and final third extrema within tolerance around an opposite middle third and applies breakout_buffer; shoulders requires matching outer-third shoulders and a middle head separated by head_margin; all regressions and thirds end at the current observed close

next-session SPY: overnight=log(open_t/close_{t-1}); intraday=log(close_t/open_t); overnight_momentum and intraday_momentum are rolling sums; continuation=rolling_mean(sign(overnight)*intraday); gap_fill=rolling_mean(clip(-sign(overnight)*intraday/abs(overnight),-2,2)), assigning zero when overnight is zero

next-session SPY: Chaikin money flow=sum((((C-L)-(H-C))/(H-L))*V,window)/sum(V,window); centered MFI uses signed typical-price money flow; normalized Force Index=EMA(diff(C)*V)/EMA(abs(diff(C)*V)); normalized Ease of Movement uses midpoint change*(H-L)/V; Klinger uses recursive trend, DM and CM volume force then EMA_fast-EMA_slow minus its signal and scales by EMA_slow(abs(volume_force)); consensus is mean sign

trailing next-session log returns only: apply causal dilated Haar, db2, db4 or adjacent-block MODWT filters at scales 1..scales; energy_j=rolling_mean(detail_j^2,window); shares=energy_j/sum_j energy_j; emit first-scale high_frequency_share, final-scale low_frequency_share, normalized Shannon energy_entropy or Herfindahl energy concentration sum_j(shares_j^2)

trailing-only fixed-rule EMD: inside each completed return window find strict local extrema, linearly interpolate and extrapolate upper/lower envelopes, subtract their mean for sift_iterations, remove each IMF and repeat components times; EEMD averages the same endpoint over deterministic seeded Gaussian ensembles; emit standardized IMF1, IMF2, residual or absolute endpoint oscillation_share

rolling SSA on each completed return window: subtract the window mean; construct the embedding by K trajectory matrix; compute full SVD; endpoint contribution_k=s_k*u_k[-1]*v_k[-1]; trend=mean+component1, oscillation=sum selected components 2..components, residual=last return minus selected reconstruction, concentration=s_1^2/sum(s^2)

one-sided next-session decomposition: trend is rolling_mean(log_return,trend_window); for weekday, month and turn-of-month buckets estimate mean(return-trend) from matching observations in [t-window,t-1], requiring 3 prior occurrences and explicitly exclude the current return; normalize every component by return volatility from [t-window,t-1]; combined=trend+the three prior-only seasonal components

causal trailing matrix profile at each t: query is the final subsequence; candidates must end before query_start-exclusion; raw or row-z normalized RMS distance selects neighbors; candidate continuation is return immediately after each candidate and is already observed before the query; emit nearest discord_score, fraction within radius, mean motif_follow_through or neighbor_dispersion

within each completed return window construct delay vectors of embedding coordinates, standardize each coordinate and mark Euclidean recurrence when distance/sqrt(embedding)<=radius, excluding self-links; recurrence_rate is recurrent share; determinism and laminarity are recurrent-point shares in diagonal or vertical runs of at least minimum_line; recurrence_entropy is Shannon entropy of qualifying diagonal lengths

on the cumulative path of each completed return window estimate generalized H(q) as the log-log slope of mean(abs(path_t-path_{t-lag})^q) over lags 1,2,4,8,16,32 divided by q; Hurst=H(2), roughness=mean absolute path increment/path standard deviation, fractal_dimension=2-H(2), multifractal_width=H(q_low)-H(q_high); sign by window direction and optionally reverse

causal empirical-EVT state: from the previous window only choose k=ceil(tail*window) largest absolute returns and threshold at rank k; tail_frequency is recent-quarter exceedance share minus tail; tail_magnitude=max(abs(r_t)-threshold,0)/past_sigma; stress_duration is consecutive current exceedances/window; hill_tail_index=1/mean(log(top_k/threshold)), capped at 20; sign by past 20-return direction and optionally reverse

next-session variance recursion initialized from rolling population variance: EWMA=decay*v_prev+(1-decay)*r_t^2; garch_proxy uses alpha=.8*(1-decay), beta=decay and omega=max(1-alpha-beta,0)*rolling_variance; asymmetric_ewma scales negative squared shocks by 1+asymmetry and adjusts alpha=(1-decay)/(1+.5*asymmetry); emit annualized volatility, r_t^2/v_prev-1 innovation, log downside/upside filtered variance or filtered/rolling variance gap

rolling causal AR threshold forecast: within each completed return window fit y=r_t on x=r_{t-lag} separately by x quantile regimes; SETAR selects the regime of the current return, STAR blends low/high predictions by logistic transition_speed, observable_threshold uses the selected regime historical mean; emit forecast/past_sigma, scaled regime_state, transition_probability or high-minus-low regime_spread; three regimes require threshold_quantile<0.5

at each refit t use only the prior window predictors and next-session log-return targets already known at decision t: AR regresses r[t+1] on r[t..t-p+1]; ARMA first fits that ridge AR, forms one-sided residuals and refits with q residual lags; distributed_regression additionally includes current and lagged log-volume changes; emit raw forecast, forecast divided by trailing target sigma, final known residual innovation or 1-MSE/variance fit quality

causal multivariate system over known SPY log return, log-volume change and joined VIX/VXO log change: VAR fits all three next-session changes on lags 0..p-1; VECM adds the current residual from the full trailing-sample regression log(SPY)=a+b*log(volume)+c*log(VIX); ridge system is refit only on prior rows and emits return forecast, forecast/residual sigma, standardized common state or error-correction state

core_causal_5 is exactly (F003,F015,F021,F032,F039), each as-of joined at or before the decision; at refit standardize the prior window, apply SVD, retain components principal loadings and orient each by prior same-session SPY-return correlation or positive F003 loading; emit weighted current factor score, retained explained share, reconstructed common direction or residual dispersion

causal quantile regression of already-known next-session SPY log return on current and lagged returns: standardize the prior window, solve the frozen 40-step asymmetric IRLS pinball approximation with ridge for tail, median, upper-tail and requested quantiles; monotonize low/median/high only for distribution diagnostics; emit requested quantile/sigma, interpolated P(return>0)-0.5, interquantile range/sigma or median skew/sigma

bounded least-squares SVM on core_causal_5=(F003,F015,F021,F032,F039): standardize prior window, select support_vectors deterministic equally spaced rows, construct linear, RBF or polynomial Gram matrix, solve alpha=(K+ridge*I)^-1*(y-mean(y)); emit forecast/sigma, tanh directional score, signed kernel-contribution alignment or maximum current support similarity

bounded deterministic tree ensemble on core_causal_5: random_forest bootstraps each prior-window sample and chooses the best of fixed 20/40/60/80 percent split candidates; extra_trees keeps all rows and draws three seeded thresholds per selected feature; every node samples max_features without replacement, stops at depth or min_leaf, and predicts leaf mean; emit ensemble forecast/sigma, direction vote, tree dispersion/sigma or average leaf support share

strongly regularized one-hidden-layer MLP on core_causal_5: standardize inputs and next-return target on each prior window, initialize deterministic seeded weights, train all weights and biases by frozen full-batch gradient descent for epochs using tanh or ReLU and L2 ridge; emit standardized forecast, centered direction probability, hidden-unit dispersion or bounded absolute model confidence

short causal temporal-convolution model over exactly five channels (known SPY return,F003,F015,F021,F032): form trailing sequence only, standardize channels on prior training sequences, apply seeded normalized tanh convolution filters with kernel and dilation at every valid past position, concatenate mean-pooled and endpoint activations, and learn a ridge next-return readout; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, endpoint-filter dispersion or endpoint/whole-path activation concentration minus one

reservoir_or_small_rnn over the same five causal temporal channels: standardize prior sequences, use seeded input weights and recurrent matrix scaled to spectral_radius; reservoir masks recurrent links to 20 percent density while small_rnn uses an orthogonal dense recurrent matrix; update tanh state with leak and fit only a ridge readout to known next returns; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, final state energy or cosine alignment between final and mean path state

compact causal attention or mixture-of-experts on core_causal_5 trailing lookback: standardize prior sequences; attention uses current query dot every past/current key divided by sqrt(5)*temperature, softmax context and ridge readout of query+context; MoE buckets prior sequences by volatility, trend or standardized hybrid gate quantiles and fits one ridge current-state expert per bucket; emit forecast z-score, centered direction probability, normalized attention entropy or cross-expert forecast disagreement

use the official current-vintage daily size portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(low-size)-return(high-size); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(low)-log1p(high)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily book-to-market portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-BM value)-return(low-BM growth); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(value)-log1p(growth)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily operating-profitability portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-profitability)-return(low-profitability); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(high)-log1p(low)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily investment portfolios released at the next SPY session; for 3, 5 or 10 bins define d=return(low-investment conservative)-return(high-investment aggressive); over the trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(conservative)-log1p(aggressive)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior 12-to-2-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Hi PRIOR winner)-return(Lo PRIOR loser); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(winner)-log1p(loser)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior one-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Lo PRIOR loser)-return(Hi PRIOR winner); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(loser)-log1p(winner)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage daily 10 portfolios sorted on prior 60-to-13-month return and released at the next SPY session; define d=return(Lo PRIOR long-term loser)-return(Hi PRIOR long-term winner); over trailing W released rows emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(loser)-log1p(winner)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5; no forward holding return enters the signal

use the official current-vintage monthly beta portfolios; treat YYYYMM as the completed month end and release it only at the tenth SPY session of the second following month; for 5 or 10 bins define d=return(high-beta)-return(low-beta); over trailing W released months emit mean(d), mean(d)/(population_std(d)/sqrt(W)), sum(log1p(high)-log1p(low)), or mean(1[d>0])-0.5

use official current-vintage monthly total-variance and residual-variance portfolios, each released only at the tenth SPY session of the second following month; for 5 or 10 bins define each d=return(high-variance)-return(low-variance), apply the same four rolling statistics over W released months, then emit total, residual, their arithmetic mean, or total-minus-residual disagreement

use official current-vintage monthly accrual and net-share-issue portfolios, each released only at the tenth SPY session of the second following month; for 5 or 10 bins define each quality spread d=return(low-characteristic)-return(high-characteristic), apply the same four rolling statistics over W released months, then emit accruals, net_share_issues, their arithmetic mean, or accruals-minus-net_share_issues disagreement

use official current-vintage 48-industry daily returns released at the next SPY session; C_i(t,W)=sum(k=0..W-1,log1p(r_i,t-k)) and B(t)=mean_i(1[C_i>0]); emit level B-threshold, change B-B(t-change_lag), or divergence B-trailing_W_mean(B); current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

on the same released 48-industry returns define M_i(t)=sum(k=skip..skip+W-1,log1p(r_i,t-k)); require at least 80 percent of industries and compute N from the available industries only; mean or median emits top-ceil(qN) M minus bottom-ceil(qN) M, breadth emits mean_i(1[M_i>0])-0.5, and rank emits sum_i((pct_rank(M_i)-0.5)*(M_i-mean(M)))/sum_i(abs(pct_rank(M_i)-0.5)); continuation keeps the sign and reversal negates it

from each released 48-industry return row compute cross-sectional population std, interquartile range, median absolute deviation, or absolute-return HHI minus 1/N and average it over trailing W rows; mean_correlation instead emits the exact mean off-diagonal Pearson correlation over the trailing W-by-N return matrix; continuation keeps the sign and reversal negates it

use official current-vintage US FF3 daily returns released next SPY session and define trailing W sums for market_excess, SMB size and HML value; emit one named factor, their equal mean, or mean(1[sum>0])-0.5 breadth; no future factor return enters the state

on released US FF3 rows emit trailing-W mean of daily cross-factor population std, 1-abs(mean_j(sign(trailing_W_sum_j))) sign disagreement, mean_j((W/short_window)*trailing_short_sum_j-trailing_W_sum_j) regime change, or exact trailing-W mean off-diagonal factor correlation; require short_window<W when regime_change is selected

declared proxy only: compare shared market_excess, size and value columns from current-vintage developed-ex-US five-factor returns with US FF3 returns, both released next SPY session; D_j=trailing_W_sum(exUS_j)-trailing_W_sum(US_j); emit one D_j, equal mean(D), or mean(1[D_j>0])-0.5 breadth and optionally negate for reversal; differing portfolio universes forbid an exact-comparison claim

for Europe, Japan and Asia-Pacific-ex-Japan released market-excess returns define regional trailing-W sums M_r; spread=max(M)-min(M), breadth=mean(1[M>0])-0.5, rank=sum((pct_rank(M)-0.5)*(M-mean(M)))/sum(abs(pct_rank(M)-0.5)), and weighted_vote=sum(M/rolling_W_std)/sum(1/rolling_W_std); continuation keeps sign and reversal negates it

use released developed-market SMB size, HML value, RMW profitability and CMA investment factor returns; form trailing-W sums and coefficients equal_weight=(1,1,1,1), size_value=(1,1,0,0), quality_investment=(0,0,1,1), or quality_minus_speculation=(-1,-1,1,1); combine by equal coefficient weight, inverse trailing volatility, or signed factor vote

use official released WML momentum for Europe, Japan, Asia-Pacific-ex-Japan and optionally developed-ex-US and all-developed; after skip rows define each trailing-W sum and apply the exact F162 mean, median, breadth or rank aggregation, then keep continuation sign or negate for reversal; overlapping aggregate universes are explicit choices, never silently mixed

use released market-excess returns for Europe, Japan, Asia-Pacific-ex-Japan and explicit optional developed-ex-US or all-developed aggregates; define each trailing-W sum and breadth B=mean(1[sum>0]); emit level B-threshold, change B-B(t-change_lag), or divergence B-trailing_W_mean(B); overlapping aggregate universes remain explicit and current-vintage revision warning remains mandatory

use official current-vintage H.10 daily observations only after the following Monday 4:15 ET release (or following business day) plus the next SPY session; convert AUD NZD GBP quotes to currency-per-USD by reciprocal; over W released weeks compute official_broad=log(broad_t/broad_t-W), cross_mean=mean_i log(fx_i,t/fx_i,t-W), breadth=mean_i(1[log change_i>0])-threshold, divergence=official_broad-cross_mean, or dispersion=population_std_i(log change_i); continuation keeps sign and reversal negates it

declared USD funding-pressure proxy, not a cross-currency rate differential: on H.15 rows released next SPY session define cash_level=rolling_zscore(US Treasury 3m yield,long_window), offshore_basis=rolling_zscore(Eurodollar 3m minus Treasury 3m,long_window), carry_pressure=cash_level-offshore_basis, and fx_adjusted_pressure=carry_pressure times sign(log broad H.10 dollar change over W sessions); continuation keeps sign and reversal negates it; no foreign policy rate or tradable FX forward is claimed

on the nine unified H.10 currency-per-USD crosses released weekly define M_i(t)=log(fx_i,t-skip/fx_i,t-skip-W); require at least 80 percent of crosses; mean or median emits top-ceil(qN) M minus bottom-ceil(qN) M, breadth emits mean_i(1[M_i>0])-0.5, and rank emits sum_i((pct_rank(M_i)-0.5)*(M_i-mean(M)))/sum_i(abs(pct_rank(M_i)-0.5)); continuation keeps sign and reversal negates it

on the causally released monthly World Bank crude-oil average, Australian coal and US natural-gas prices define M_i=log(P_i,t/P_i,t-W); level is mean rolling normalization_window zscore of log prices, momentum is mean_i(M_i), and breadth is mean_i(1[M_i>0])-threshold; require at least 80 percent of the frozen energy set and optionally negate for reversal

on released monthly prices define industrial M as the mean W-month log change of aluminum copper lead tin nickel and zinc and precious M as the mean for gold platinum and silver; emit industrial_momentum, precious_momentum, industrial_minus_precious, breadth=mean across all nine of 1[M_i>0]-0.5, or cross-sectional population dispersion of M_i; require 80 percent of each selected group and optionally negate for reversal

on released monthly cocoa Arabica Robusta palm oil soybeans maize rice wheat beef sugar and cotton prices define W-month log changes; level is mean rolling normalization_window zscore of log prices, momentum is their mean and breadth is mean(1[change>0])-threshold; require at least 80 percent of the frozen agriculture set and optionally negate for reversal

on the union of frozen energy industrial precious agriculture and fertilizer prices compute W-month log changes and require at least 80 percent; breadth=mean(1[M_i>0])-threshold, dispersion=population_std(M_i), inflation_pressure=mean(M_i)/population_std(M_i), and concentration=sum((abs(M_i)/sum abs(M))^2)-1/N; optionally negate for reversal

align only already released inputs to SPY decisions and form four W-session trends: SPY log return, H.10 broad-dollar log return, Treasury-bond proxy=-8*change(yield10)/100+lag(yield10)/100*W/252, and equal-weight released commodity log-price change; sign_breadth=mean(sign(SPY,-USD,bond,commodities)), volatility_scaled_mean=mean of each trend divided by its trailing normalization_window std with USD sign reversed, dispersion=population std of those scaled trends, and stock_minus_defensive=scaled SPY minus mean(scaled USD and bond); optionally negate for reversal

declared constant-maturity proxy only: for maturity m in 2y 5y 10y 20y with frozen modified duration D and previous curve tenor p, carry=lag(y_m)/100*W/252, roll=D*(lag(y_m)-lag(y_p))/100*W/(252*(m-p)), momentum=-D*(y_m-lag_W(y_m))/100, and total=carry+roll+momentum; raw emits the component and rolling_zscore subtracts its trailing z_window mean and divides by trailing population std; no futures or tradable bond roll is claimed

construct daily SPY log return and bond proxy return=-D*change(yield_m)/100+lag(yield_m)/100/252 from H.15 released next session; correlation is trailing-W Pearson correlation, decoupling is correlation_W-correlation_long_window, sign_change is sign(correlation_W) when its sign differs from correlation_long_window and zero otherwise, and beta is trailing covariance(SPY,bond)/variance(bond); require long_window>window where used and optionally negate for reversal

on H.15 constant-maturity yields released next SPY session define level=y10, slope_10y_3m=y10-y3m, curvature_2_5_10=2*y5-y2-y10, and long_curvature_5_10_20=2*y10-y5-y20; raw keeps the selected statistic, change subtracts its change_lag value, and rolling_zscore uses trailing window population mean and std; continuation keeps sign and reversal negates it

declared constant-maturity algebra proxy only: forward_2y5y=(5*y5-2*y2)/3, forward_5y10y=(10*y10-5*y5)/5, forward_slope=forward_5y10y-forward_2y5y, butterfly=2*y5-y2-y10, and slope_shock=(y10-y2)-lag_shock_lag(y10-y2); apply raw, change or trailing rolling_zscore and optional reversal; these are not tradable forward quotes

declared official SPF expected-real-rate proxy: after each survey quarter ends use the next SPY session and column 6 of the median RR1_TBILL_CPI, RR1_TBILL_PCE or RR1_TBILL_PGDP sheet; basis median takes the row median of available bases; emit level, W-quarter change, cross-basis population dispersion, or trailing-W-quarter zscore tightness; this is not an ex-post nominal yield minus realised inflation series

on released H.15 yields define baa_aaa=BAA-AAA, aaa_treasury=AAA-y10, baa_treasury=BAA-y10, and credit_stress_composite as the equal mean of their trailing-window zscores; then apply raw, change or rolling_zscore and optional reversal

after conservative commercial-paper releases define quality_spread=A2P2_nonfinancial90-AA_nonfinancial90, financial_spread=AA_financial90-AA_nonfinancial90, outstanding_contraction=-log(CP_outstanding/lag_lag(CP_outstanding)), issuance_intensity=short-maturity issuance_amount/CP_outstanding, and spread_volume_composite as the available-component mean of trailing-window zscores; outstanding begins in 1993, AA rates in 1997, A2P2 in 1998 and issuance in 2001, so unavailable components remain null rather than truncating the panel; the frozen batch default is raw outstanding_contraction; apply raw, change or rolling_zscore and optional reversal

after H.8 release define bank_credit_growth=log(bank_credit/lag_lag), loan_growth=log(loans/lag_lag), loan_share=loans/bank_credit, credit_breadth=mean across bank credit securities loans C-and-I real-estate and consumer-loan growth signs minus 0.5, and composition_dispersion as the population std of securities C-and-I real-estate and consumer-loan log growth; apply raw, change or rolling_zscore and optional reversal

declared money-and-credit proxy, not income velocity: after H.3 H.6 and H.8 release define money_growth=log(M2/lag_lag), liquid_share=M1/M2, reserve_growth=log(total_reserves/lag_lag), borrowing_pressure=log1p(fed_borrowings)-log(total_reserves), and credit_money_ratio=bank_credit/M2; apply raw, change or rolling_zscore and optional reversal

declared consumer-credit composition proxy, not delinquency or household distress: after G.19 release define total_growth and revolving_growth as lag-log changes, revolving_share=revolving/total, revolving_relative_growth=revolving_growth-nonrevolving_growth, and consumer_credit_stress as mean(zscore(revolving_share),zscore(relative_growth),-zscore(total_growth)); apply raw, change or rolling_zscore and optional reversal

align only released curve credit commercial-paper bank money and Cboe states; define stress components as trailing-window zscores of negative 10y-3m slope, BAA-AAA, A2P2-AA CP spread, negative bank-credit lag-log growth, log1p(borrowings)-log(reserves), and bridged VIX level; emit equal composite, fraction positive minus 0.5 breadth, maximum stress, or cross-component population dispersion and optionally reverse

align only released credit commercial-paper bank reserves and Cboe states; over shock_lag define VIX change, BAA-AAA change, A2P2-AA CP-spread change, negative bank-credit log change and negative reserve log change, then zscore each over trailing window; emit joint_mean, joint_max, fraction above threshold shock_breadth, VIX*credit*bank triple_interaction, or trailing-window mean breadth persistence and optionally reverse

at each Philadelphia Fed quarterly vintage compute annualized quarter growth for the latest known real output and real GDI observations; output_growth and gdi_growth select either series, average_growth requires both and is their equal mean, growth_spread=output_growth-gdi_growth, revision_breadth is the mean sign of each available series revision versus the preceding vintage for its latest common historical observation, and growth_breadth is the fraction of available positive growth rates minus 0.5; official real GDI vintages begin in 2005, so the frozen full-history batch default is output_growth and joint variants remain unavailable before 2005; apply raw, event-row change or event-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

at each Philadelphia Fed quarterly vintage compute annualized latest-quarter growth for nominal consumption and nominal disposable income plus the latest saving-rate level and quarter change; consumption_income_gap is consumption growth minus income growth and household_breadth is the fraction positive across consumption growth, income growth and saving-rate change minus 0.5; apply raw, event-row change or event-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

after conservative official first-release availability, forward-fill only past releases of annualized quarter growth in nonresidential and residential investment plus the housing-starts level; housing_starts_change is lag-log change, investment_breadth is fraction positive across both investment growth rates and housing change minus 0.5, housing_investment_composite is their equal trailing-window zscore mean, and revision_composite is the equal trailing-window zscore mean of second-minus-first releases; building permits are deliberately absent; apply raw, event-row change or event-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

after conservative official first-release availability, forward-fill only past releases of headline CPI, core CPI and core PCE; headline_core_gap=headline CPI-core CPI, inflation_breadth is their equal mean, and revision_pressure is the official core-PCE second-minus-first release revision; the official downloadable headline-CPI and core-CPI files contain no second-release column values in the 1998-2010 train interval and are therefore not falsely represented as revision signals; apply raw, event-row change or event-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

align to each SPY decision date only previously released payroll first values and second-minus-first revisions with the latest Philadelphia Fed real-time unemployment level and change; labor_breadth is fraction positive across payroll level, payroll revision and negative unemployment change minus 0.5, while labor_composite is their equal trailing-session zscore mean; apply raw, session change or session rolling zscore and optional reversal

after conservative official first-release availability, forward-fill only past releases of annualized monthly growth in total and manufacturing industrial production plus total and manufacturing capacity-utilization levels; utilization_spread is total minus manufacturing capacity, production_breadth is fraction positive across both production growth rates and lag changes in both capacity series minus 0.5, production_capacity_composite is their equal trailing-window zscore mean, and revision_composite uses second-minus-first revisions; apply raw, event-row change or event-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

after the SPF survey quarter ends, compute RGDP current-quarter and next-quarter annualized growth from frozen median level columns plus median current-quarter unemployment, CPI, housing growth and T-bill forecasts; macro_outlook_composite is the equal trailing-quarter zscore mean of output, housing, negative unemployment, negative CPI and negative T-bill; apply raw, quarter-row change or quarter-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

after the SPF survey quarter ends, use current-quarter interquartile ranges for NGDP, unemployment, CPI, housing and T-bill forecasts; macro_disagreement is their equal trailing-quarter zscore mean and disagreement_breadth is the fraction above each series trailing median minus 0.5; apply raw, quarter-row change or quarter-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

match each SPF output forecast to the official first-release output value for exactly the same target quarter and expose no error before that release; statistics are forecast_revision, signed or absolute current-nowcast error, signed or absolute prior-quarter forecast error, trailing-quarter current-nowcast bias, and trailing-quarter mean absolute error; apply raw, release-row change or release-row rolling zscore and optional reversal

from official SLOOS series delayed to the first SPY session on or after 60 calendar days after quarter end, use net tightening standards and net stronger demand for large-medium and small firms plus five loan-term tightening measures; term_tightness is the five-term mean, supply_breadth and demand_breadth are fractions positive minus 0.5, supply_demand_gap is mean standards minus mean demand, and composite_tightness is mean standards-and-terms minus mean demand; apply raw, quarter-row change or quarter-row rolling zscore and optional reversal; current revised history is not claimed as historical-vintage PIT exact

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months define household_liquid=checkable_deposits+time_deposits+money_market_fund_shares; statistics are household_equity/household_financial_assets, household_liquid/household_financial_assets, household_equity/household_liquid, event-row change in equity share, and rolling_z(equity_share)-rolling_z(liquid_share); apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months define household_liquid as checkable plus time deposits plus money-market-fund shares; statistics are liabilities/financial_assets, liquid_assets/liabilities, quarter growth in liabilities, quarter growth in liquid assets, and rolling_z(liquidity_growth)-rolling_z(liabilities_growth); apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months define corporate_liquid=checkable_deposits+time_deposits+money_market_fund_shares; statistics are liabilities/financial_assets, liquid_assets/financial_assets, debt/liabilities, quarter growth in liquid assets, and rolling_z(liquid_share)-rolling_z(liabilities_to_assets); apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months use nonfinancial-corporate net equity issuance at its published annual rate; statistics are the annualized flow, annualized flow/current financial assets, event-row flow change, and rolling zscore of issuance/assets; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months define mutual-fund equity share=corporate_equity/total_assets, quarterly flow rate=(annualized total-asset transactions/4)/prior-quarter total_assets, quarter asset growth, and equity_share*flow_rate; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

use the actual current-download Z.1 ETF sector, which has nonzero train coverage from 1993 and needs no fallback, delayed 13 months; statistics are ETF corporate_equity/total_assets, quarterly flow rate=(annualized total-asset transactions/4)/prior-quarter assets, quarter asset growth, and ETF asset growth minus mutual-fund asset growth; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 money-market funds delayed 13 months define quarterly flow rate=(annualized total-asset transactions/4)/prior-quarter assets, quarter asset growth, Treasury share, commercial-paper share, and Treasury share minus commercial-paper share; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 broker-dealers delayed 13 months define liabilities/assets, repo_liabilities/assets, repo_assets/assets, quarter asset growth, and rolling_z(asset_growth)-rolling_z(liabilities/assets); apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

combine current-download Z.1 rest-of-world annualized purchases of Treasuries, bonds, equities and mutual-fund shares delayed 13 months with official TIC Treasury and equity net purchases delayed to the tenth SPY session of the second following month; statistics are TIC Treasury, TIC equity, their sum, summed Z.1 foreign flow, equal mean of rolling zscores of TIC total and Z.1 total, and TIC equity minus Treasury; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

from current-download Z.1 delayed 13 months define sector-scale ratios household_money_fund_shares/mutual_fund_assets, mutual_fund_assets/broker_assets and broker_assets/corporate_liabilities; statistics are each ratio, mean or maximum of their rolling zscores, and that mean plus 0.5 times the rolling zscore of broker repo liabilities/assets; a flat repo-share window contributes neutral zero after full history; apply raw, event-row change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; proxy only, no historical-vintage claim

use the official VXO close before 2003-09-22 and modern-methodology VIX thereafter, with each close usable only on the next SPY session; statistics are level, log level, lagged log trend, trailing zscore, trailing percentile and VIX-minus-VXO overlap spread; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

from next-session official VXO/VIX closes define daily d=diff(log(vol_index)); statistics are annualized trailing standard deviation of d, trailing mean absolute d, annualized root-mean-square positive d, annualized root-mean-square negative d, and a trailing zscore of vol-of-vol; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

align only next-session official VXO/VIX and SPY closes; implied_variance=(vol_index/100)^2 and realized_variance=252*trailing_mean(diff(log(SPY))^2,realized_window); statistics are each variance, implied-realized spread, implied/realized ratio, log ratio and trailing zscore of the spread; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

from next-session official VXO/VIX define daily log change and a shock when the current level exceeds the chosen quantile of the preceding full trailing window; statistics are positive log shock, shock indicator, consecutive shock duration, level/trailing-peak minus one, negative lagged average log change as normalization speed, and trailing percentile; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

the frozen D_CBOE_PCR artifact is not put-call data but the preregistered official CFTC futures-only cross-market fallback; after Friday release compute across markets the fraction with positive commercial net position minus 0.5, corresponding noncommercial breadth, their gap, lagged commercial-breadth trend and trailing commercial-breadth zscore; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; never label this lane put-call

using the same explicit CFTC futures-only cross-market fallback after Friday release, compute mean absolute commercial-minus-noncommercial net-position difference and cross-market commercial-position dispersion; statistics are disagreement, lagged disagreement change, disagreement zscore, dispersion, dispersion zscore and disagreement zscore minus breadth-gap zscore; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal; never label this lane put-call

aggregate only preregistered S&P 500 legacy futures-only CFTC contracts and expose Tuesday data after Friday release; statistics are commercial net position/open interest, lagged change, trailing zscore, trailing percentile and commercial net share times the zscore of log open interest; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

aggregate only preregistered S&P 500 futures-only CFTC contracts and expose Tuesday data after Friday release; statistics are noncommercial net/open interest, noncommercial short/open interest, spreading/open interest, lagged noncommercial-net change and noncommercial net minus spreading share; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

for preregistered S&P 500 CFTC contracts released Friday compare futures-only with futures-and-options-combined reports; statistics are futures-only minus combined commercial net share, futures-only minus combined noncommercial net share, incremental combined open interest/combined open interest, combined minus futures-only spreading share and combined minus futures-only top-four net concentration; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

from preregistered S&P 500 futures-only CFTC reports released Friday use aggregate open interest, its report growth, reported trader count, trader-count growth, top-four and top-eight net concentration, top-eight minus top-four gap, and an equal mean of trailing zscores of open-interest growth plus absolute top-four and top-eight concentration; apply raw, report change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

join each public FOMC decision event to the last already available effective federal-funds rate; expose rate change between decision events, sign, magnitude, elapsed calendar days, meeting-minus-statement count and conference-call flag; never use future meeting dates

from public FOMC statement dates only, exposed next SPY session, compute elapsed days between statements, lagged gap change, trailing gap zscore, annualized publication frequency, absolute deviation from the trailing median gap and elapsed days since the latest statement; no text or tone is claimed

from public FOMC minutes-release dates only, exposed next SPY session, compute days since the latest public meeting, lagged publication-delay change, trailing delay zscore, gap between minutes releases, gap zscore, annualized release frequency and elapsed days since release; no minutes text or tone is claimed

causally align the latest public statement and minutes-release states and expose signed cadence gap, absolute cadence disagreement, absolute recency gap, which publication is newer and joint standardized irregularity; never infer semantic disagreement from unavailable text

aggregate Treasury auctions by the frozen physical record or issue date and expose on the next SPY session: offered, accepted and tendered dollars, accepted-to-offered ratio, log offer growth and accepted-minus-offered dollars; net cash is unavailable and is not claimed

on the same conservatively delayed Treasury auction aggregates compute tendered divided by accepted, accepted-weighted clearing rate using high yield then high investment or discount rate, lagged yield and demand changes, trailing demand-minus-yield zscore balance and auction count

weight each auction maturity and security-type bucket by offered dollars, then expose weighted years, bill share, note-and-bond share, at-least-ten-year share, reopening share, three-bucket maturity HHI and refinancing pressure equal to offer zscore times bill plus reopening share

expose Debt-to-the-Penny record rows on the next SPY session and compute total debt, log growth, growth acceleration, public-held share, intragovernmental share, lagged public-share change and trailing debt-growth zscore; optional composition starts only when physically present

after the frozen conservative TIC release lag use only the physically available Treasury and equity sector histories; expose combined, official and residual private flow, signed equity share of absolute flows, official shares by sector and signed equity-minus-Treasury allocation tilt; agency and corporate classes are unavailable and excluded

causally align public FOMC event activity, released total-reserve growth, Treasury offer growth and conservatively delayed TIC Treasury purchases after separately standardizing each event history; expose policy-reserve interaction, reserve-minus-issuance balance, foreign-flow-minus-issuance absorption, reserve-times-foreign alignment, policy-issuance interaction and a four-input composite

group official Philadelphia real-time rows by their physical vintage publication date, expose on the next SPY session, and compute vintage count, resource breadth, publication gap, annualized frequency, lagged breadth change, negative mean latest-observation age and resource breadth divided by publication gap; apply raw, event change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

use only Treasury fields already public on each announcement date, expose them on the next SPY session, and compute announcement count, announced dollars, gap, rolling count, offer-weighted maturity, maturity-bucket HHI, announcement-to-auction lead days and offer zscore times count divided by gap; exclude auction-result fields not known at announcement

count public FOMC meeting, statement and minutes-release events by physical publication date, expose them on the next SPY session, and compute count, publication gap, rolling density, each document-kind share, mix entropy and lagged entropy change; exclude the noncausal meeting-date minutes link and all unavailable text or tone

after the conservative TIC publication lag compare physically available foreign Treasury and equity net purchases and official purchases; expose total and official divergence, lagged divergence change, trailing divergence zscore, sign disagreement, Treasury-to-absolute-equity ratio and rolling cross-asset correlation; current downloadable histories do not recreate historical revisions

clean only physical NOAA New York GSOD precipitation, visibility, fog, rain and snow fields, expose each observation after a two-calendar-day guard, and compute precipitation, precipitation event, precipitation zscore, visibility, fog, snow depth and precipitation zscore minus visibility zscore plus fog; sunshine and cloud history are unavailable and never claimed

clean physical NOAA New York GSOD temperature, dewpoint, pressure, wind, maximum wind, gust and daily extrema, expose each observation after a two-calendar-day guard, and compute level, trailing anomaly, temperature range, dewpoint spread, pressure anomaly, wind, gust, absolute temperature anomaly and wind zscore plus half gust zscore minus pressure zscore

from deterministic New York session dates compute approximate daylight minutes at LaGuardia latitude, daily daylight change, U.S. DST state using the historical pre-2007 and post-2007 rules, a five-day transition window, signed distance to the nearest transition and clock-change direction; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

from the deterministic bounded session calendar mark the first or last three sessions of each month, quarter and year, the sessions before and after a greater-than-three-day calendar gap, standard third-Friday expiry, quarterly expiry and sessions until expiry; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

derive the deterministic four-year U.S. federal election cycle and statutory general-election date for each session; expose cycle year, election-year and midterm flags, signed and absolute election distance, ninety-day pre and post windows and sine-cosine cycle encoding; apply raw, session change or rolling zscore and optional reversal

create same-session pulses only after each Philadelphia vintage, FOMC public document and Treasury announcement is available, combine them with deterministic month-turn and expiry pulses, and compute current count, rolling total density, fixed type-weighted density, active-family breadth, HHI concentration, macro-policy overlap and weighted density times concentration; never drag event values into future pulses
